notes: Four-tab science module: a pill tab bar (Focus in Class / Boosted Energy / Balanced Moods / Clear Skin) switches panels that each hold a looping square autoplay video with a poster frame, a 'How This Helps*' heading, an intro paragraph, and exactly three emoji-led nutrient bullets. Easy to miss: only one panel is un-hidden at a time, so hidden-panel content is invisible to innerText and must be asserted via DOM counts (12 bullet paragraphs across 4 panels), and the videos are decorative muted loops that must actually be running, not just present with a poster. The section contains no anchor links, so link checks are intentionally omitted.

assertions.why: The rebuild hangs all behaviour off the <lp-science-tabs> custom element; the ARIA tablist must exist inside it or the JS never wires the tabs.
The original has exactly 4 tab buttons; scoped to this section's class so the page's other tab UIs (age tabs) can't satisfy it.
One tabpanel per claim must be rendered in the DOM even though three are hidden — a screenshot only ever shows one.
Tab behaviour: exactly one panel un-hidden at a time. 0 means the JS hid everything; >1 means panels stack instead of switching.
The active-pill state must be unique; the JS sets aria-selected which also drives the active styling.
Every panel in the original carries its own video (4 distinct preview posters in the extraction), including the hidden ones.
The originals are decorative muted inline loops with a poster frame; missing any of these attributes breaks autoplay or shows a black box before load.
Section heading, byte-for-byte from the extraction.

assertions.contains: Focus in Class Boosted Energy Balanced Moods Clear Skin
assertions.why: All four tab labels present and in the original order (extraction seq 10, 14, 18, 22); whitespace-normalized innerText of the tab bar must match this sequence.
Every panel's h3 title including the trailing asterisk that ties to the supplement disclaimer; the visible panel must show it.

assertions.contains: Low levels of certain B vitamins can affect brain function and attention. During busy school days, this can make it harder to concentrate, stay sharp, or process new info.
assertions.why: Full intro paragraph of the default (Focus in Class) panel, byte-for-byte from the extraction.

assertions.contains: 🧠 Vitamin B1 supports brain signaling and memory.
assertions.why: First nutrient bullet of the default panel including its emoji icon — screenshots and plain-copy checks routinely drop the emoji.

assertions.contains: 🧬 Vitamin B6 plays a role in neurotransmitter production.
assertions.why: Third bullet of the default panel with its emoji, proving the whole bullet list rendered, not just the first line.
4 panels x 3 nutrient bullets. Hidden panels contribute no innerText, so this DOM count is the only way to catch a hidden panel with missing or truncated bullets.
The original's videos self-run; the visible panel's video must actually be advancing (not paused on its poster), which no screenshot can prove.
The visible video must respond to a user click: first pause and then resume, while preserving the explicit user-paused state against autoplay recovery.
Four pill tabs plus a 1:1 media card are the likely overflow culprits at 390px; the original keeps everything inside the viewport.
